property.description: Shows CoworkingView Price Index figures for one city.
City slug, for example berlin. Lowercased and sent as the city query parameter of GET /v1/market/rates.
Maximum number of product rows to show, from 1 to 50. Omit it to show every published product. Not sent to the API.
